```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(caret)

classification <- read.csv("output/classification_data.csv", header = TRUE)
reference <- read.csv("output/reference_data.csv", header = TRUE)
```

```{r}
accession_to_organism <- c(
    "NC_004722.1" = "bacillus_cereus",
    "NC_004721.2" = "bacillus_cereus",
    "NC_000913.3" = "escherichia_coli",
    "NC_000907.1" = "haemophilus_influenzae",
    "NC_000915.1" = "helicobacter_pylori",
    "NC_008530.1" = "lactobacillus_gasseri"
)
classification$predicted_organism <- accession_to_organism[classification$Most.Similar.Reference]
classification$correct <- classification$predicted_organism == classification$Actual.Reference
```

```{r}
ggplot(classification, aes(x = Actual.Reference, y = ..count..)) +
    geom_bar() +
    labs(title = "Distribucija stvarnih referenci", x = "Stvarna referenca", y = "Broj fragmenata") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
ggplot(classification, aes(x = seq_along(Actual.Reference), y = Cosine.Similarity, color = correct)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(title = "Kosinusna sličnost po fragmentu", x = "Fragment", y = "Kosinusna sličnost") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "green"), labels = c("Pogrešno", "Točno")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```
